name: Sodium dicyclohexyl sulfosuccinate
description: Sodium dicyclohexyl sulfosuccinate (CAS 23386-52-9 ) is an anionic surfactant from the sulfosuccinate family, valued for its strong wetting and dispersing performance across industrial and specialty formulations. Its diester structure with cyclohexyl groups delivers effective surface tension reduction in systems where conventional surfactants underperform. In water treatment, it functions as a wetting agent and dispersant. This chemical improves penetration and particle suspension in treatment formulations. Personal care and cosmetic manufacturers incorporate it into cleansing and emulsified products where controlled foam is required. Uniform dispersion is essential for these applications. In printing and packaging, it aids ink wetting and substrate adhesion, improving print quality on difficult surfaces and specialized materials. Textile, leather, and paper processing operations use it to enhance fiber penetration during dyeing, tanning, and coating steps. This reduces processing time and improves overall product uniformity. Sodium dicyclohexyl sulfosuccinate is typically supplied as a liquid solution or paste. Technical grade is the standard commercial form for industrial applications, with concentration levels varying by supplier. End-use requirements dictate the specific concentration needed for each process.
